_about: Hand-measured additions to the extracted walls, updated to the lighting plan of 2026-07-07. Units: metres. x runs left to right on the plan, z runs from the garden (negative) towards the street. Origin: back-left corner of the 9 x 12 m house volume. Heights are absolute, with the ground floor finished floor at 0.
_plan_note: Walls are extracted from this set (solid wall fills). Changes in the newest set (lighting plan 2026-07-07) are applied below as manual edits; see tools/compare_plans.py.

interiors._note: Heated inside of each floor. Walls within 11 cm of this outline (and everything outside it) get facade brick; the rest is plaster.
